label: the long edge is ignored: every photo plans at its full size
a photo smaller than the long edge is enlarged to it (fitting becomes a fixed size)
replace: let size = options.longEdge.map { PixelSize(width: $0 * full.width / max(full.longSide, 1), height: $0 * full.height / max(full.longSide, 1)) } ?? full

label: develop is skipped: render returns the decoded buffer
find: let buffer = try develop.render(preShrunk(b, photo: photo, longSide: longSide), settings: photo.develop)
replace: let buffer = try preShrunk(b, photo: photo, longSide: longSide)

label: the plan ignores the crop: photo.develop.crop is read as nil
the cropped size takes the photo's aspect at the crop's long side
the policy is not passed: the writer drops nothing
uniqueNamesInOnePass: taken names keep only each stem's base, not the name a photo got, so a third copy repeats a name
taken names compare with case, so IMG and img both get one name
the parsed-once stems pad {seq} to one digit
the source isn't shrunk: develop runs on all 24 MP of a 2,000 px export
find: guard full > longSide, longSide > 0 else { return b }

label: the shrink ignores the crop: it stops once the whole photo covers the plan, so the crop lands short (1022 x 682)
the grow loop is gone: the shrink stops at the plan's scale and its crop lands short of the plan
find: !covers(planned, photo: photo, at: source.fitting(longSide: side)) { side += 1 }
replace: !covers(planned, photo: photo, at: source.fitting(longSide: side)) { break }

label: the cover check is off by one: a crop a pixel short of the plan counts as covering
the grow loop steps two pixels: the shrink overshoots the smallest size that covers
the final resize is skipped: the export ships at the developed crop's size, not the plan's
find: return try LiveResize.resized(buffer, width: target.width, height: target.height)

label: the final resize fits the developed shape to the long side instead of sizing to the plan
replace: let target = PixelSize(width: buffer.width, height: buffer.height).fitting(longSide: longSide)
